title.narrative: Reduced local pollution and greenhouse gas emissions

description.narrative: This indicator measures the net change in the GHG emissions (net of GHG emissions induced) relative to the assumed business as usual or baseline scenario for typical year of operation, in tons of CO2 equivalent (tons CO2 eq.). The business as usual scenario should be as accurate as possible based on realistic assumptions allowable within the local legislation/context. The assumptions should be clearly stated. If in doubt, choose more conservation assumptions.End of project estimates should include assumption reflecting the realities of the project, e.g. in terms of the infrastructure that are actually built/in operation, processes implemented, etc. Any assumptions made at the start of the project that were subsequently deemed biased, incompletely or otherwise inaccurate should be corrected for the estimation at the end of the project.

title.narrative: Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions avoided (tonnes CO2eq) with EU support

description.narrative: SDG 13 Climate ActionFor more information about the GE RF methodological notes please check https://europa.eu/capacity4dev/eurfi

comment.narrative: The full name of indicator in contract LF is 1.1. Amount of greenhouse gas emissions induced avoided reduced or sequestered per year EFSD ReMF GERF 2.7. The whole LF for this intervention is basedshared with the Contribution Agreement NDICI ASIA2023 448851 Inclusive and Climatesmart lnvestment Financing in the Livestock sector in the Republic of Uzbekistan Tranche 2 which is providing 2nd tranche of EU financing totaling 115M without fees to the overall project. To prevent double counting the indicator values will be split pro rata basis 6040 between two interventions as indicated in the respective contracts. In this case target of the overall LF is 31000 tCO2 where 18600 t will be attributed to this intervention while 12400t to the LF of INTV26231 tranche 2.
